common_query_mask.draw_timing: Before external current mask-independent feature forward
common_query_mask.isolated_mask_seed: Required explicit integer; mask_generator separate from native/global/initializer streams
common_query_mask.sampler: Uniform fixed-size subset via private CPU torch.Generator randperm
common_query_mask.visible_positions: A minus Q; one shared owner-issued exclusion field recomputed each update

conditional_inverse_inclusion.claim: Conditional message/residual-logit first moments only at fixed parameters and mask-independent current feature/attention fields
conditional_inverse_inclusion.inference_allowed_anchors: All legal A; heldout query IDs disjoint from A

corrector_update.backbone_boundary: Both full H and base logits explicitly detached; no native parameters/optimizer owned
corrector_update.failure: Partial counters retained; update-phase error marks core failed and rejects further updates/serving; no automatic retry
corrector_update.ordering: One corrector zero_grad, four ownCE/4 backwards at unchanged corrector parameters, one corrector Adam step

fixed_operation.Q_and_K: Separate feature-only shared matrices with private BE r/s; detached H only
fixed_operation.attention: Dot product /sqrt64 and stable per-target softmax over every supplied incoming nonself edge record
fixed_operation.corrected_logits: detach(base_logits)[query_ids] + delta_m(detach(H), graph, permitted visible labels)
fixed_operation.duplicates: Retained in original order/multiplicity; same node-label inclusion indicator for all duplicate contributions
fixed_operation.output: One bias-free BE linear class map; no nonlinear post-aggregation operation, propagation, label-derived score, raw-feature value or bias
fixed_operation.query_row_restriction: Retains all fixed neighbors of each requested row, no neighbor sampling or label-dependent edge filtering
fixed_operation.values: Zero at every node outside permitted visible TRAIN anchors; learned shared class embedding then bias-free BE value map
fixed_operation.zero_value_neighborhood: Exactly zero correction at all finite parameter states; empty-neighborhood exact-zero guard present

initializer.K_input_factor_r: Pinned standard Rademacher initializer at initializer_seed+900003
initializer.Q_input_factor_r: Pinned standard Rademacher initializer at initializer_seed+900001
initializer.final_output_weight: Shared W exactly zero before any update
initializer.other_factors: All s and V/O r one
initializer.shared_maps: Standard CPU Linear/Embedding reset, explicit float32

native_integration.feasible_capture_source_fact: Pinned WikiBackbone.forward models.py72-83 captures full active head input and computes full logits before ID indexing; a separate read-only head hook could collect both in the same forward without an extra draw
native_integration.future_required_stage_policy: Native own-local model/Adam restoration; coherent corrector model/Adam at that same epoch; declared live end-local native/mask streams

serving.requires: Full current feature-only H/base; legal observed graph; all permitted TRAIN labels; heldout IDs disjoint_A

unresolved_risks.alternative_potential_anchor_denominator: Not implemented; would require separately defined successor with fixed A including masked Q, never visible-only renormalization
unresolved_risks.drifting_native_representation: Concurrent changes to H/base can hamper corrector learning
unresolved_risks.label_sparsity_dilution: Most normalization mass may fall on zero-valued neighbors; Q/K may receive little useful signal
unresolved_risks.native_TRAIN_confidence: Native fitting of all TRAIN labels can weaken corrected CE feedback
